entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Symbiotic novae are slow irregular eruptive variable stars with very slow nova-like outbursts with an amplitude of between 9 and 11 magnitudes. The symbiotic nova remains at maximum for one or a few decades, and then declines towards its original luminosity. Variables of this type are double star systems with one red giant, which probably is a Mira variable, and one a hot compact object, with markedly contrasting spectra and whose proximity and mass characteristics indicate it as a symbiotic star.
